title: Drosophila CNS Dissection and Fixation
author: Geoffrey W. Meissner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qjydupw

steps.title: Prepare ethanol and S2 wells
steps.instruction: Set up a glass well plate with three wells: fill one well with 70 % ethanol and the other two with cold Schneider’s Insect Medium (S2); place a sticky dot next to the ethanol well to distinguish it.

steps.title: Anesthetize and ethanol‑dip flies
steps.instruction: Anesthetize flies using CO₂ or cold, grasp each fly by the wings or legs with forceps, briefly submerge it in the 70 % ethanol well for 2 seconds, immediately dip it in the first cold S2 well, then transfer it to the second cold S2 well where it will remain until dissection; do not use a transfer pipette between wells to avoid ethanol contamination.

steps.title: Keep flies on ice
steps.instruction: Place the dish containing the ethanol‑rinsed flies in the second S2 well on ice and keep them submerged until dissection, ensuring that the total time from anesthesia to dissection does not exceed 20 minutes to prevent tissue death and post‑mortem changes.

steps.title: Dissect brains in cold S2
steps.instruction: Transfer each rinsed fly to a Sylgard‑lined dissection dish containing cold S2, dissect the CNS, and replace the S2 puddle with fresh cold S2 whenever it becomes littered with debris; complete all dissections within the 20‑minute window before fixation.

steps.title: Fix brains in 2 % PFA
steps.instruction: Within 20 minutes of dissection, move the dissected brains to a 2 mL Protein LoBind tube containing approximately 1.9 mL of 2 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) in S2 at room temperature (RT); incubate for exactly 55 minutes at RT on a nutator, covering the tube to protect the tissue from light.

steps.title: Rinse fixation with PBT
steps.instruction: Place the fixation tubes upright to let the tissue settle, aspirate the PFA solution with a transfer pipette, fill the tube with phosphate‑buffered saline containing 5 % Triton X‑100 (PBT) at RT, invert the tube a few times, let the tissue settle, aspirate the rinse, and add ~15 µL of RT PBT to aid sinking of the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Add RT PBT to fill the tube.
Allow tissue to settle, then aspirate the rinse.
Add ~15 µL RT PBT to help tissue sink.

steps.title: Perform four PBT washes
steps.instruction: Add 1.75 mL of RT PBT to each tube, nutate for 10–20 minutes at RT, protect from light, and repeat this wash a total of four times.

substeps.instruction: Repeat steps 1–3 for a total of four washes.

steps.title: Store tissue in 0.5 % PBT
steps.instruction: Transfer the washed brains to 0.5 % PBT and store at 4 °C; nutate or lay the tubes flat in a covered box on a rotator (do not store upright) and protect from light. Samples can be kept up to 3 days; if stored longer than overnight, aspirate the old PBT and perform a brief wash with fresh 0.5 % PBT before beginning immunohistochemistry.
